apps.name: ORBIT LOCK
apps.subtitle: Catch a wandering satellite.
apps.description: Acquire the amber gate as your satellite crosses it. Each lock tightens the window. Three missed alignments end the expedition.

apps.name: MOONRUNNER
apps.subtitle: Leave footprints in the dark.
apps.description: Cross a crystal desert with a stubborn little survey robot. Tap to jump; hold briefly for more height. Your best distance is saved.
apps.controls: TAP TO JUMP · HOLD FOR HEIGHT

apps.name: UNDERTOW
apps.subtitle: Follow the silent current.
apps.description: Pilot a small craft through an impossible ocean. Hold to rise, release to sink, and thread the openings between ancient columns.
apps.controls: HOLD TO RISE · RELEASE TO SINK

apps.name: ECHO VAULT
apps.subtitle: Return the signal you receive.
apps.description: Watch and hear a growing pattern. Reproduce it with short taps and long holds. Each successful sequence opens another chamber.

apps.name: LIGHT TRIAL
apps.subtitle: Measure the space before action.
apps.description: Press to arm a trial. Wait for the middle physical light to turn green. ESP32 button trials use the node clock; keyboard trials use approximate screen timing.
apps.controls: WAIT FOR LIGHT II · THEN PRESS

apps.name: GLYPH ARCHIVE
apps.subtitle: Remember a forgotten language.
apps.description: Memorize the inscription before it disappears. The cursor cycles through six glyphs; press to rebuild the sequence. Three mistakes seal the archive.
apps.controls: PRESS TO CHOOSE THE LIT GLYPH

apps.name: PULSAR
apps.subtitle: Keep time with a dying star.
apps.description: Beats fall down three lanes toward the strike line. Tap on the beat; hold through the long signals.
apps.controls: TAP ON THE BEAT · HOLD LONG SIGNALS · LAMPS SWELL FIRST
apps.icon: <path d="M4 24h9l4-12 6 24 5-18 3 6h13"/><circle cx="24" cy="24" r="21" stroke-dasharray="2 5"/><circle cx="43" cy="24" r="2" fill="currentColor"/>

apps.name: PERIHELION
apps.subtitle: Swing between small suns.
apps.description: Hold to tether to the nearest anchor and swing. Release to fly on. Distance is everything.
apps.controls: HOLD TO TETHER · RELEASE TO FLY

apps.name: DESCENT
apps.subtitle: Set down gently, or not at all.
apps.description: Hold to burn against gravity and settle on the pad before the fuel runs out. The lamps are your descent-rate indicator.
apps.controls: HOLD TO BURN · RELEASE TO FALL

apps.name: RICOCHET
apps.subtitle: Break the lattice.
apps.description: The paddle never stops. Tap to reverse it and keep the signal bouncing through the lattice.

apps.name: HELIX
apps.subtitle: Grow without crossing yourself.
apps.description: A signal thread that only turns one way. Tap to turn, gather fragments, and do not touch your own trail.

apps.name: BALLISTA
apps.subtitle: Launch probes through the wind.
apps.description: The aim sweeps by itself. Hold to charge, release to launch, and allow for the wind.
apps.controls: HOLD TO CHARGE · RELEASE TO LAUNCH

apps.name: SIGNAL SCHOOL
apps.subtitle: Speak in dots and dashes.
apps.description: Learn the alphabet through a progressive Morse lesson. The lights and optional sidetone follow your key. Beginner letter gaps are deliberately forgiving.
apps.controls: TAP A DOT · HOLD A DASH

apps.name: CHRONOMETER
apps.subtitle: Keep time beyond this screen.
apps.description: Create up to eight persistent background timers. A completed timer announces itself without interrupting a game’s physical lights.

apps.name: FIELD NOTES
apps.subtitle: Let the room tell its story.
apps.description: Local speech-to-text with visible microphone status, saved sessions, and text export. Recording continues when you leave this screen; mute is always in the system menu.

apps.name: ATMOSPHERE
apps.subtitle: Observe the world around you.
apps.description: Temperature and relative humidity from your SHT3x, with local history. Simulator readings are explicitly marked and stored separately.

apps.name: NODE SCOPE
apps.subtitle: Look inside the instrument.
apps.description: Live button state, light-channel checks, microphone level, sensor readings, and communication counters.

apps.name: CALIBRATION
apps.subtitle: Make the console your own.
apps.description: Sound, volume, phosphor texture, reduced motion, Morse speed, and button hold duration. All controls work with one button.

apps.name: LANTERN
apps.subtitle: Carry a little light.
apps.description: The three lamps as a lamp: colours, brightness and slow scenes, with a night-light that switches itself off.

apps.name: CADENCE
apps.subtitle: Count the beat and the laps.
apps.description: A metronome with tap tempo, a stopwatch with laps, and work/rest intervals shown on the lamps.

apps.name: EPHEMERIS
apps.subtitle: Know where the sky is.
apps.description: The time, the Moon's phase, sunrise and sunset for your location, and a small orrery. All computed locally.

apps.name: RESONANCE
apps.subtitle: See what the room sounds like.
apps.description: Sound level, spectrum and pitch from the microphone. Nothing is recognised or stored.

apps.name: ORACLE
apps.subtitle: Ask the dark for a number.
apps.description: Dice, coins, random picks and yes-or-no answers, rolled across the lamps.

apps.name: TELEMETRY
apps.subtitle: Listen to the machine itself.
apps.description: Health of the Pi and the node: temperature, load, memory, storage, link and firmware.
